# Alert

<!-- MAP:START (generated by .kiro/scripts/build-docs.py from rp-map.json) -->
**`rp-alert`** = `Alert` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/Alert` · Figma: Alert · no class = `variant="warning"`

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-alert-confirmation` | variant="confirmation" |
| `rp-alert-info` | variant="info" |
| `rp-alert-error` | variant="error" |
| `rp-alert-compact` | compact |
| `rp-alert-multiline` | multiline |
| `rp-alert-content` | AlertContent (children) |
| `rp-alert-title` | bold first line |
| `rp-alert-actions` | AlertActions |
| `rp-alert-close` | onClose button |
<!-- MAP:END -->

An inline message on the page or in a tile. `Alert` default is `variant="warning"`.

```html
<div class="rp-alert rp-alert-info" role="status">
  <span class="rp-icon rp-icon-info"></span>
  <div class="rp-alert-content">When you change your email, we send a confirmation link to the new address.</div>
</div>
<div class="rp-alert rp-alert-error" role="alert">
  <span class="rp-icon rp-icon-error"></span>
  <div class="rp-alert-content"><strong class="rp-alert-title">Review source disconnected</strong>Connect Google again to reply to reviews.</div>
  <div class="rp-alert-actions"><button type="button" class="rp-ghost-button">Connect</button></div>
  <button type="button" class="rp-icon-button rp-alert-close" aria-label="Close alert"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-close"></span></button>
</div>
```
| Variant | Icon | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `confirmation` | `check` | Something finished and stays relevant |
| `info` | `info` | Context the user should know |
| warning (no class) | `warning` | Something needs attention soon |
| `error` | `error` | Something failed or blocks the work |

Inside a tile, above its title: wrap it in `<div class="rp-tile-alert">` (TileAlert).

## Rules
- What happened and what to do, 1–2 sentences. Never "Something went wrong".
- Use a snackbar, not an alert, to confirm an action the user just did.
